requirements.title: PENDING= tests previously pending asynchronous transfers
requirements.definition: PENDING= determines whether data transfers that were pending at the beginning of INQUIRE execution are complete.

pending.pending-previously-pending-definition: Source-use plan: future asynchronous cases establish the pending state before INQUIRE; a variable initialized to the opposite logical value prevents vacuous success.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive INQUIRE plans first establish the connection or file state being observed, initialize every inquiry variable to a nonmatching sentinel value, execute INQUIRE, and assert only values fixed by 12.10.2: exact tokens such as UNDEFINED or UNKNOWN, logical true/false where specified, zero/nonzero IOSTAT where 12.11 later permits it, or bounded set membership where the source gives a set. Processor-dependent file names, case interpretation, multi-unit choices, file storage unit counts, asynchronous completion policy, IOMSG text, and numeric status codes are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself is a numbered syntax rule or numbered constraint and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. Undefined inquiry variables are not read as an oracle; IOMSG wording and processor-dependent numeric status values are never compared.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and earlier clause 12 catalogues for source form, names, expressions, execution constructs, units, connections, file access, file position, CLOSE/OPEN context where already registered, and data-transfer foundations. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later clause 12 OPEN, asynchronous transfer, I/O status, data transfer, internal-file, and input/output-item rules; clause 13 formatting and modes; clause 15 defined I/O; clause 16 inquiry/status intrinsics where future fixtures need them; clauses 3, 5, 14, 17, 18, and 19 where terminology, constants, images, IEEE support, deleted features, or scope/lifetime controls are reached.

requirements.title: PENDING= with complete ID= transfer returns false and waits for that transfer
requirements.definition: If ID= appears and that data transfer is complete, PENDING= is assigned false and INQUIRE performs the wait operation for the specified transfer.

pending.pending-id-complete-false: No portable oracle until a future asynchronous fixture can obtain an ID for a transfer known complete before INQUIRE; completion timing is processor dependent.
pending.pending-id-complete-wait: No portable oracle for the wait side effect without the same established complete asynchronous transfer and a post-wait observable owned by asynchronous I/O rules.

requirements.title: PENDING= without ID= returns false and waits when all previous transfers are complete
requirements.definition: If ID= is omitted and all previously pending transfers for the unit are complete, PENDING= is assigned false and INQUIRE performs wait operations for all such transfers.

pending.pending-all-complete-false: Use a connection with no previously pending transfers, initialize PENDING to .true., inquire without ID=, and expect false; a separate asynchronous-complete case waits for future async support.
pending.pending-all-complete-waits: No portable oracle for actual wait operations without a pending asynchronous transfer whose completion state is independently established.

requirements.title: PENDING= returns true and performs no waits in all other cases
requirements.definition: In all other cases, PENDING= is assigned true, no wait operations are performed, and previously pending transfers remain pending after INQUIRE.

pending.pending-other-cases-true: No portable oracle: creating a transfer that a processor must still consider pending at INQUIRE time is not guaranteed by the standard.
pending.pending-other-cases-no-wait: No portable oracle for absence of a wait without a guaranteed still-pending asynchronous operation.
pending.pending-other-cases-remain-pending: No portable oracle for continued pending state because processors have latitude in completion policy.

accounting.rationale: NOTE lists possible processor completion policies; not normative.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10, the INQUIRE statement and all thirty-four inquiry specifiers (batch165). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across three rounds. Round 1 split the 'unable to determine' latitude out of eight YES/NO/UNKNOWN specifiers and out of ENCODING and SIZE; round 2 made the plans assert only what that latitude leaves portable - membership in {YES, UNKNOWN} for a method in use, and {POS-1, -1} for the size of a stream file. R1230, R1231 and C1247-C1251 were pre-accounted. With this packet Clause 12 is fully registered. Source accounting only.
